summary: Viking Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting two ordinary capital-raising transactions: a $35.00/share equity offering of 7,857,143 shares plus a fully exercised 1,178,571-share option, grossing roughly $316 million and netting about $297 million, underwritten by Morgan Stanley and J.P. Morgan and closed September 25, 2026 under its automatic Form S-3 shelf; and a $225 million principal offering of 2.00% convertible senior notes due 2032. These are routine shelf takedowns and debt incurrences, not a special situation; watch dilution, note conversion overhang, and use of proceeds rather than any deal-arbitrage angle.
